events.title: VALERIUS ORDERS A NEW SURVEY OF THE OUTER ESTATE LANDS
THE NEWLY SURVEYED TRACT IS DIVIDED INTO FIELDS AND RETURNED TO PRODUCTION
OLD BOUNDARY WITNESSES CONFIRM THAT THE NEW TRACT WAS LEFT OUT OF EARLIER MEASUREMENTS
VALERIUS FILES FOR FORMAL RECOGNITION OF HIS EXPANDED ESTATE
CELER AND MARCELLUS RECEIVE THE RECOGNITION DOSSIER AND PASS IT INTO THEIR POLITICAL NETWORKS
THE FIRST RESTORED FIELDS OF THE EXPANDED ESTATE SHOW A FULL WORKING CYCLE
VALERIUS'S NOVEMBER DOSSIER LEAVES THE ESTATE READY FOR FORMAL REVIEW
